quarterly_data.quarter: Bitdeer Technologies press release: Bitdeer Announces August 2026 Production and Operations (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Bitcoin mining, August 2026: mined 1,310 Bitcoins (July 1,190; August 2025 375), an increase of 249% year-over-year; self-mining hash rate ~79.9 EH/s (July 76.7); total proprietary hash rate 84.1 EH/s; co-mining hash rate 21.6 EH/s, using Bitdeer's mining rigs operated by third-party datacenters; BTC held 61. Company: 'we continue to expect momentum in our mining results over the coming months.'
